title: Throughput shadow ledger: staffing rebalance & pricing scan (Oct 2026)
summary: Working worksheet that maps token-throughput scenarios to a shadow ledger of staffing rebalancing and pricing trigger points. Purpose: give finance + infra a compact operational playbook for short-term runway preservation when token demand shifts across model mixes, regions, and latency classes.
key_assumptions: 1) Baseline unit cost (hosted) = $0.0035 per 1k inference tokens (mixed model set). 2) Dedicated capacity per-GPU fixed monthly cost = $9,000 incl. infra overhead; scaling effective at 16k concurrent tokens/sustained. 3) Quantization & batching optimizations can change unit token cost by -15% to -40%. 4) Hiring lead times: infra engineer 8 wks, SRE 6 wks, infra ops contractor 2 wks. 5) Pricing elasticity: 5% price move => ~2.2% change in usage in mid-market segment (observed).
scenarios_overview: We run three 12-week scenarios: Stabilize (moderate growth + favor batching), Surge (2.5x token peak for 6 weeks), and Degrowth (20% sustained drop). Each produces staffing rebalancing suggestions and pricing trigger rules. Focus is on short-cycle reallocation (contractor swaps, burst GPU leases) and a conservative price floor for enterprise slabs.

pricing_triggers_and_rules:
- If 7d rolling unit cost > baseline + 12% => open price-protection window for new free-tier signups and activate contracted burst (avoid enterprise SLA changes).
- If 14d rolling usage growth > 60% and avg latency SLO violation > 2% => accelerate burst pool + raise short-term enterprise slab pricing by 8% (notify legal).
- If capacity burn for dedicated customers exceeds committed GPU slots for 3 consecutive days => throttle non-committed routes and apply a replenishment surcharge per-token (configurable).
runway_and_headcount_triggers:
- Hiring freeze lift: only when 12w pro-forma with batching shows >10% margin improvement.
- Convert contractors: if surge persists beyond week 8, convert 50% of contractors to fixed hires (infra engineers).
- Opex rebalancing: trade SRE FTE -> infra automation in Degrowth scenario to realize 6-week cash savings.
recommendations:
1) Fund a $260k short-duration 'burst reserve' (12w) to cover contractor + leased GPU spikes — triggers auto-deploy when Surge path probability >30%.
2) Run a targeted 8-week quantization pilot on the top 3 memory-heavy models (expected -18% unit cost). Finance to reserve one-time $40k for tooling & retraining.
3) Implement a real-time cost dashboard (Cost Ops) with 24/7 alerts for unit-cost drift thresholds (+/-8%).
4) Update enterprise slab contracts with a flexible surcharge clause for capacity overruns and a minimum price floor tied to model-mix unit cost.

notes_and_context: This artifact is a working finance-originated ledger intended for rapid ops coordination. It intentionally blends headcount, short-term contracting, and pricing levers to give product and infra practical options for handling throughput shocks. Not final: numbers are estimates and should be reconciled with actual infra telemetry and contract quotes before exec sign-off.
